raw_response:
This rented wheat plot is small, so I will try to manage it carefully and not spend too much. Because wheat usually does better with some chemical fertilizer, I will use a modest amount, but I will keep using my own local seed since improved seed costs more and is not easy for me to get. I do not have irrigation, and for this plot I will mostly rely on family labor, with no need to hire many people. I will not use manure here because I keep that for other plots closer to home.
